forbidden_pattern: (?i)(describe(d)? the style|from memory|style adjectives|palette words|match the style in prose)
message: SVG geometry-to-style work is drifting toward prose-only style transfer. Build/attach the visual style packet and actual references.

unless_pattern: (?i)(test artifact|smoke test|not the successful method|attachment-aware prompt package|blocked)
message: Prompt-only output is not the successful geometry-to-style adaptation method when the workflow requires image attachments.
A geometry metric PASS is only a rejection gate. Require visual judge review for style, cutouts, and full-frame artifacts.
When geometry is approved but style is wrong, route to attachment-aware whole-panel redraw using the geometry image as a composition map.
